scientific_integrity: Exact exhaustive oriented-necklace search with a proved twenty-symbol base cutoff, fully reproduced by an embedded standalone standard-library program; algebra and logic were reviewed internally, with no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The enumeration concerns primitive two-sided periodic points of finite differentiability depth at most ten. It does not assert any periodic point in the infinitely differentiable shift, nor an exact formula at depths above ten. The 16 orbits are counted modulo shift only. The novelty comparison is subject to specialized prior literature not surfaced by the targeted searches.
title: Exact shortest periods and extremal orbit counts in the first ten Kolakoski finite-depth shifts
